name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - flavor: fedora
            buildsystem: meson
            tests: unit
            omemo: signal
            script: ./scripts/build-configuration-matrix.sh
            omemo_env: libsignal
          - flavor: ubuntu
            buildsystem: meson
            tests: unit
            omemo: signal
            script: ./scripts/build-configuration-matrix.sh
            omemo_env: libsignal
          - flavor: debian
            buildsystem: meson
            tests: unit
            omemo: libomemo
            script: ./scripts/build-configuration-matrix.sh
            omemo_env: libomemo-c

    name: ${{ matrix.flavor }} | ${{ matrix.tests }} | ${{ matrix.omemo }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Run tests
        env:
          OMEMO_BACKEND: ${{ matrix.omemo_env }}
        run: |
          docker build -f ci/Dockerfile.${{ matrix.flavor }} -t profanity .
          docker run ${OMEMO_BACKEND:+ -e OMEMO_BACKEND} profanity ${{ matrix.script }}

  macos-homebrew:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    name: macos | unit | libomemo
    env:
      HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE: 1
      HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALL_CLEANUP: 1
      HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALLED_DEPENDENTS_CHECK: 1
    steps:
      - name: Set up Homebrew
        uses: Homebrew/actions/setup-homebrew@main
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          brew install \
            cmocka \
            gdk-pixbuf \
            gettext \
            glib \
            gpgme \
            libomemo-c \
            libotr \
            libstrophe \
            meson \
            ninja \
            pkgconf \
            lua \
            qrencode \
            readline \
            sqlite \
            terminal-notifier

      - name: Run build matrix and unit tests
        env:
          OMEMO_BACKEND: libomemo-c
        shell: bash
        run: |
          BREW="$(command -v brew)" ./scripts/build-configuration-matrix.sh meson

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
